job_description_info.job_description:
# Senior Data Engineer – Data Platform

**Company:** Halden Pay (fictional name; cross-border business payments)
**Location:** Lisbon, Portugal (hybrid, 3 days per week in the office)
**Team:** Data Platform

## The role

Halden Pay is growing quickly, and data sits at the centre of that plan. We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join the Data Platform team. The team builds and runs the shared data platform that analysts, data scientists and product teams rely on, with a focus on reusable frameworks rather than one-off pipelines.

## Responsibilities

- Own the design, build and day-to-day running of the company's central data platform
- Evaluate and introduce new open-source tools where they bring a clear benefit
- Work with data scientists, analytics engineers and BI colleagues to turn their needs into platform features
- Define and enforce data quality standards, governance rules and access policies

## Tech stack

- Cloud: Google Cloud (BigQuery, Cloud Run, GKE)
- Orchestration and transformation: Airflow, dbt
- Engineering: Python, SQL, Docker, CI/CD, Git

## Requirements

- Experience designing, building and operating production data platforms or cloud data warehouses at scale
- Advanced Python and SQL, including query optimisation on large datasets
- Strong data modelling skills (dimensional modelling; graph modelling is a plus)
- Hands-on experience with Google Cloud or a comparable cloud (managed warehouse, serverless compute, containers)
- Curiosity about new data architecture ideas and open-source practices
- Good professional English; Portuguese is a plus

If you meet most but not all of the points above, you are still welcome to apply.

## Benefits

- Base salary plus annual bonus
- Training and certification budget
- Support for open-source contributions
- Hybrid work from a central Lisbon office

LENA VARGA-HOLM
Senior Data Engineer
Rijeka, Croatia (open to remote, EU time zones) | lena.vargaholm@example.com | +385 55 555 0101 | github.com/lvh-data-example

PROFILE
Data engineer with 9 years of experience building batch and streaming data platforms for e-commerce and payments. I like boring, well-tested pipelines, clear data contracts and warehouses that analysts actually trust.

EXPERIENCE

Senior Data Engineer - Lukovac Freight Hub d.o.o. (logistics marketplace), Rijeka            03/2022 - present
- Own the ingestion layer of the company data platform: ~140 Airflow DAGs loading from Postgres, MySQL, Salesforce and 3rd-party APIs into Snowflake.
- Moved transformation logic from stored procedures to dbt (420+ models, tests on every model); nightly run time down from 5h10 to 1h35.
- Introduced data contracts between product teams and the data team (JSON Schema + CI checks), cutting broken-pipeline incidents from ~9/month to ~2/month.
- Built a Kafka-based event pipeline (Kafka Connect + Snowpipe Streaming) for shipment tracking events, ~30M events/day.
- Mentor two mid-level data engineers; run the weekly data platform office hours.

Data Engineer - Kovalent Pay (payments startup), Zagreb                            09/2019 - 02/2022
- Built PySpark jobs on AWS EMR for transaction reconciliation (daily ~1.2 TB of raw files from S3).
- Designed the Redshift warehouse schema (star schema, 30+ fact/dimension tables) used by finance and risk.
- Set up data quality checks with Great Expectations on critical finance tables.
- Wrote internal Python library for S3/Glue catalog access used by 4 teams.

Junior Data Engineer / BI Developer - Adria Retail Group, Split                     06/2017 - 08/2019
- Maintained SSIS packages and T-SQL ETL into an on-prem SQL Server warehouse.
- Built Power BI reports for store operations (40+ stores).
- Migrated 60 nightly SSIS jobs to Python scripts scheduled with cron.

EDUCATION
MSc Computer Science (Data Science track) - Northgate Technical University, 2017
Thesis: Incremental materialized views for analytical queries

SKILLS
Languages: Python, SQL, Bash
Data: Airflow, dbt, Spark (PySpark), Kafka, Kafka Connect, Snowflake, Redshift, PostgreSQL, Great Expectations
Cloud & infra: AWS (S3, EMR, Glue, Lambda, IAM), Docker, Terraform (basic), GitHub Actions
BI: Power BI, Looker (basic)

LANGUAGES
Croatian (native), English (C1), German (B1)

company_info.company_description:
Halden Pay is a fintech in the financial-services industry, providing business accounts, foreign-exchange risk management and trade finance to exporters. Its work is focused on helping business clients manage payments and international trade needs.

The company’s stated values are **Together, Ownership and Pace**: sharing information and supporting colleagues across teams, taking responsibility and learning from problems, and simplifying work so it can move quickly for clients. Halden Pay describes its culture as commercially driven, with friendly colleagues and an emphasis on collaboration and personal development. It offers career paths, an annual learning budget and mentoring, though employee reviews suggest onboarding and training can vary between teams.

Most offices use a hybrid model, with around three days a week in the office. Teams include product areas such as payments, risk, data platform and client experience, with team events and regular get-togethers across its roughly 40 offices.

LENA VARGA-HOLM
Senior Data Engineer | Data Platform
lena.vargaholm@example.com | +385 55 555 0101 | github.com/lvh-data-example

PROFILE
Senior Data Engineer with 9 years of experience designing, building and operating batch and streaming data platforms for e-commerce, payments and logistics. Experienced in Python, SQL, Airflow, dbt, cloud data warehouses and large-scale data processing. Focused on reliable pipelines, clear data contracts, data quality and trusted data models for analysts and business teams.

CORE SKILLS
Data platforms: Airflow, dbt, Kafka, Kafka Connect, Snowflake, Redshift, PostgreSQL
Programming: Python, SQL, Bash
Data processing and quality: PySpark, Great Expectations, JSON Schema, CI checks
Cloud and infrastructure: AWS (S3, EMR, Glue, Lambda, IAM), Docker, Terraform (basic), GitHub Actions
Data modelling and BI: Dimensional modelling, Power BI, Looker (basic)

EXPERIENCE

Senior Data Engineer - Lukovac Freight Hub d.o.o. (logistics marketplace), Rijeka | 03/2022 - present
- Own the ingestion layer of the company data platform, operating approximately 140 Airflow DAGs that load data from Postgres, MySQL, Salesforce and third-party APIs into Snowflake.
- Migrated transformation logic from stored procedures to dbt, delivering 420+ models with tests on every model and reducing nightly run time from 5 hours 10 minutes to 1 hour 35 minutes.
- Introduced JSON Schema data contracts and CI checks between product teams and the data team, reducing broken-pipeline incidents from approximately 9 per month to 2 per month.
- Built a Kafka-based event pipeline using Kafka Connect and Snowpipe Streaming to process approximately 30 million shipment-tracking events per day.
- Mentor two mid-level data engineers and lead weekly data platform office hours.

Data Engineer - Kovalent Pay (payments startup), Zagreb | 09/2019 - 02/2022
- Built PySpark jobs on AWS EMR for transaction reconciliation, processing approximately 1.2 TB of raw files from S3 daily.
- Designed a Redshift warehouse using a star schema with more than 30 fact and dimension tables for finance and risk teams.
- Implemented Great Expectations data quality checks for critical finance tables.
- Developed an internal Python library for S3 and Glue Catalog access, adopted by four teams.

Junior Data Engineer / BI Developer - Adria Retail Group, Split | 06/2017 - 08/2019
- Maintained SSIS packages and T-SQL ETL workflows feeding an on-premises SQL Server warehouse.
- Built Power BI reports for store operations across more than 40 stores.
- Migrated 60 nightly SSIS jobs to Python scripts scheduled with cron.

EDUCATION
MSc Computer Science (Data Science track) - Northgate Technical University | 2017
Thesis: Incremental materialized views for analytical queries

LANGUAGES
Croatian (native), English (C1), German (B1)
